voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Virginia, eighteen eighty-five. A pamphlet goes on sale for fifty cents. It tells of treasure buried in Bedford County.
Its story: in eighteen twenty-two, a man named Thomas Beale left a locked iron box with an innkeeper. Inside, three messages, written only in numbers.
The second was decoded, using the Declaration of Independence as the key. It describes gold, silver, and jewels.
No record confirms that Beale existed. Many researchers think the pamphlet is a hoax.
But the other two messages, said to give the place and the names, have never been decoded.
